stem: A service team uses a board that shows every piece of work in progress, who owns it and where it is blocked. Which guiding principle does this MOST directly support?
options: Collaborate and promote visibility
Focus on value
Start where you are
Optimize and automate
explanation: Making work visible, for example on a board or in a workflow tool, helps identify bottlenecks, waste and blocked items, and supports better decisions. That is the visibility part of this principle.

stem: A user asks the service desk for access to a new reporting tool. What is this request, from the point of view of the service value system?
options: Opportunity
Value
Governance
Demand
explanation: Demand is the need or desire for products and services among internal and external consumers. Opportunity is an option or possibility to add value or otherwise improve the organization.

stem: Which practice aligns the organization's practices and services with changing business needs through the ongoing improvement of products, services and practices?
options: Continual improvement
Change enablement
Relationship management
Service level management
explanation: The purpose of continual improvement is to align the organization's practices and services with changing business needs through ongoing improvement of products, services, practices or any element involved in managing them.

stem: Which statement about service level management is CORRECT?
options: It should measure the availability of each server separately and ignore the business view of the service
It is responsible for fixing incidents that cause a target to be breached
It needs an end-to-end, outcome-based view of services, not only the performance of individual components
It is used only when a service is first designed and not after it goes live
explanation: Service level management provides end-to-end visibility of the organization's services and should capture the overall customer experience, not just component metrics. It continues throughout the life of the service.

stem: Which statement about a virtual service desk is CORRECT?
options: It is not allowed under ITIL because users need a physical desk
Its agents can work from several locations and appear to users as one team
It is staffed entirely by chatbots and automated tools, with no human agents at all
It can only be contacted by email
explanation: A virtual service desk lets agents work from multiple locations, geographically dispersed, supported by technology so the desk still acts as one point of contact.

stem: A project team produces a new set of network diagrams for an operations team. What are the diagrams?
options: A service
A value stream
An outcome
An output
explanation: An output is a tangible or intangible deliverable of an activity. The outcome would be the result the operations team achieves using the diagrams, such as diagnosing faults faster.

stem: Which statement about how the guiding principles are used is CORRECT?
options: They are used only when designing brand new services, and never when improving the existing services or practices
They can be adopted and adapted to guide decisions in any initiative and in all relationships with stakeholders
They replace the need for governance, practices and the service value chain
They are used only by the service desk when dealing directly with users
explanation: The guiding principles apply to almost any initiative and relationship, at every level of the organization. They are one component of the service value system and work alongside governance, practices and the value chain.

stem: Which statement about the four dimensions of service management is CORRECT?
options: Each dimension is managed by a separate team that does not need to work with the others
They replace the need for guiding principles in the service value system
They apply to the service value system as a whole and to each product and service
They apply only to the design of new services, not to their operation
explanation: The four dimensions should be considered for the whole service value system and for every product and service. Failing to address all four can lead to services that do not deliver value as intended.

stem: Which practice captures demand for incident resolution and service requests, and is the entry point and single point of contact for users?
options: Relationship management
Service request management
Incident management
Service desk
explanation: The service desk captures demand for incident resolution and service requests, and is the entry point and single point of contact for the service provider with all of its users.

stem: A provider sends a short survey to users after each support interaction and reviews the results with the customer every quarter. Which practice uses this information to manage service targets?
options: Service level management
Deployment management
Monitoring and event management
Change enablement
explanation: Customer feedback, from surveys and key business measures, is one of the information sources for service level management, alongside customer engagement, operational metrics and business metrics.

stem: Why should service desk staff understand the wider organization and its business processes?
options: So they can understand the user's situation and the impact of an issue on the business
So they can resolve every technical fault themselves without involving any of the support teams
So they can set the targets in service level agreements
So they can authorize changes requested by business users
explanation: A key aspect of a good service desk is practical understanding of the wider organization, its business processes and users, so it can understand impact, prioritize and communicate well.

stem: Which statement about costs in a service relationship is CORRECT?
options: Costs imposed on the consumer are not part of the consumer's value assessment
A service always removes all costs from the consumer
A service can remove some costs from the consumer and impose others on it
Only the provider needs to understand the costs of a service
explanation: From the consumer's view there are costs removed (part of the value proposition) and costs imposed (such as fees, training and infrastructure). Both are weighed when the consumer judges the value of the service.

stem: A team in IT builds reporting tools for the finance department of its own company. Which statement about 'focus on value' is CORRECT?
options: Finance is a service consumer, so the team should understand what finance values
Focus on value applies only to the external, paying customers of the company and not to internal teams
Value is irrelevant because no money changes hands inside the company
The team should decide what is valuable without consulting finance
explanation: Service consumers can be internal or external. Focusing on value means understanding what each consumer values, whether or not there is a direct payment.

stem: Which statement about practices and value chain activities is CORRECT?
options: Value chain activities are carried out without using practices
Practices are used only in the deliver and support activity
Each practice contributes to exactly one value chain activity
One practice can contribute to many value chain activities
explanation: Value chain activities use different combinations of practices, and a practice such as service desk or relationship management can contribute to several activities, such as engage and deliver and support.

stem: What is the purpose of the change enablement practice?
options: To maximize successful changes by assessing risks, authorizing changes and managing the change schedule
To reduce the likelihood and impact of incidents by finding their causes
To move new or changed hardware, software, documentation and processes into the live environments of the organization
To make new and changed services and features available for use
explanation: Change enablement maximizes the number of successful service and product changes by ensuring risks are properly assessed, authorizing changes to proceed and managing the change schedule.

stem: Which step of the continual improvement model carries out the plan for the improvement?
options: Where do we want to be?
How do we get there?
Take action
Did we get there?
explanation: 'Take action' executes the plan for the improvement, which may follow a waterfall or an agile approach, and stays open to feedback and changing circumstances.

stem: Which statement about automation on the service desk is CORRECT?
options: Automation means a service desk no longer needs any human agents
Automation and self-service help, but people are still needed for complex issues and empathy
Automation is used only to log incidents, never to fulfil requests
Automation should be avoided on the service desk, because users always prefer to speak to a real person
explanation: With more automation, chatbots and self-service portals, service desks can focus on supporting people and the business. Complex issues and situations needing empathy still need people.
